invalid_target.message: Invalid target: {target}. Only notifications are allowed.

selection.description: Floors, areas, devices or labels. Evaluated on every run, so new entities are included automatically.

domains.name: Entity type

name_source.name: Name source
name_source.description: Source of the names in the message.

title.name: Title
title.description: Notification title, if the target supports one.

alexa_type.name: Alexa output
alexa_type.description: Only for Alexa Media Player targets.

report_unavailable.name: Report unavailable
report_unavailable.description: Append unavailable entities to the message.
